title: Celestial Lake Pagoda
description: A woman in flowing green robes stands atop a rocky island beside a glowing traditional Chinese pagoda. The night sky swirls with purple and blue vortexes containing skeletal fish and a large golden celestial orb, while below, several small boats drift across misty green water with orange petals floating on the surface.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a woman in flowing green traditional robes standing on a rocky island next to a glowing multi-tiered Chinese pagoda. The dramatic sky is filled with large swirling purple and blue vortexes containing white skeletal fish and a bright golden celestial orb. Several wooden boats with figures float on the misty green lake below, orange petals drifting on the water, ethereal fog, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
